question: Prime Minister Narendra Modi released a commemorative postal stamp during the Second WHO Global Summit on Traditional Medicine in December 2025. The stamp was dedicated to which medicinal plant?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashwagandha.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi released a commemorative postal stamp during the Second WHO Global Summit on Traditional Medicine.**
 
• **The event was held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, on 19 December 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The commemorative postage stamp was released on Ashwagandha.**
 
• **Ashwagandha is scientifically known as Withania somnifera.**
 
• **The stamp has a denomination of ₹5.**
 
• **It was designed by the Department of Posts in collaboration with the Ministry of Ayush.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Ashwagandha**__ is a key medicinal herb used in Ayurveda for stress relief, immunity and vitality.
 
• The Second WHO Global Summit on Traditional Medicine was jointly organised by WHO and the Ministry of Ayush.
 
• The summit was held from 17–19 December 2025 in New Delhi.
 
• The release highlights India’s efforts to promote traditional medicine globally.
